name: Pierre's Year-Round Seeds
summary: Buy spring, summer and fall seeds at Pierre's in any season, for a little extra that you set yourself.
logoPrompt: A small burlap seed sack with four tiny seed packets fanned out in front of it, each packet a different seasonal colour: green, yellow, orange and white

cover.tagline: Every seed, every season, for a price.
bullets: Seeds of all seasons all year

description: **Pierre's Year-Round Seeds lets you buy the seeds of every season at Pierre's shop, all year long, for a small surcharge.**
- Spring, summer and fall seeds from Pierre's shop stay on his shelves in every season, winter included.
- Out-of-season seeds cost extra: choose +25 %, +50 % (default) or +100 % in the config.
- Seeds he sells in the current season keep their normal price and never appear twice.
- Seeds Pierre only sells from year 2 on still wait for year 2.
Install SMAPI and Content Patcher, then unzip the file into your `Mods` folder. Visit Pierre and plan next season's field ahead.
- Needs SMAPI and Content Patcher 2.9.0 or newer. Made for Stardew Valley 1.6.
- Built carefully from the documented formats of Stardew Valley 1.6 and Content Patcher.
- Crops still only grow in their own season. Buying early lets you plant on day one, it does not change the seasons.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
